van.definitionKo: 많은 사람을 태울 수 있는 대형 자동차.
van.englishDescription: A large car that can carry a lot of people.

virile.definitionKo: 글이나 말투 등이 굳세고 힘이 있다.
virile.englishDescription: A written passage, speech, etc. being strong.

warehouse.definitionKo: 여러 가지 물건을 모아 두거나 넣어 두는 곳.
warehouse.englishDescription: A place in which goods and merchandise are collected or stored.

warehouse.definitionKo: 창고에 물건을 넣다. 또는 새로운 상품을 들여오다.
warehouse.englishDescription: To put goods into a warehouse; to bring new goods into a store.

warehouse.definitionKo: 막 쓰는 물건을 쌓아 두는 창고.
warehouse.englishDescription: A storage place for keeping miscellaneous things.

wearily.englishDescription: In an exhausted and fatigued way.

wearily.definitionKo: 몹시 지치고 고단하여 몸이 축 늘어질 정도로 힘이 없이.
wearily.englishDescription: Lacking energy, feeling enervated because one is extremely tired and burned out.

weekly.englishDescription: A magazine issued once a week.

wetly.englishDescription: A word describing rain falling continuously and wetly.
In a manner of feeling and looking a little wet because of moisture.
In the manner of feeling or looking wet because of moisture.

whiskers.definitionKo: 남자 어른의 입 주변이나 턱, 뺨에 나는 털.
whiskers.englishDescription: Hair growing around the mouth, chin, or cheeks of a male adult.

wholesaler.definitionKo: 물건을 낱개로 팔지 않고 여러 개를 한꺼번에 파는 장사. 또는 그런 장수.
wholesaler.englishDescription: Business that sells products in bulk, not by the piece, or such a seller.

wristband.definitionKo: 소매에서 손이 나올 수 있게 뚫려 있는 부분.
wristband.englishDescription: The open part of a sleeve where the hand comes out.

yoreon.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '요리한' (a conjugated form of '요리하다' (do this way)).
